name: immutability-check-v2
title: Contract immutability enforcement
interface: CLI: bash tools/check-immutability.sh [<baseline-ref>]. Fails if a contract file was deleted or renamed, if a modified contract changed anything beyond its descriptive fields (title, nl_description, serves), or if laws/deprecations.log shrank or was rewritten. The semantic core (name, interface, acceptance, env) changes only by revision. Exits 0 silently when the baseline ref does not exist.
nl_description: The git-native form of prove2me's statement immutability, scoped to what actually carries trust: the semantic core is locked so partial work composes and audits stay valid, while descriptive metadata may be edited freely - a typo fix must not cost a revision.
